task_instance: Take one named bug (the bundled planted-bug fixture: app.py whose save() writes an upload named '../escape.txt' outside the uploads directory) in a small local Git repo, drive the skill's workflow to produce its core deliverable: a local patch commit plus the reviewable proof reports (report.html, and maintainer-report.html when the patch is verified) generated by the bundled records.py / render.py pipeline, including the regression-hunt campaign over baseline..patch_commit.
blocker_detail: The skill is a multi-agent orchestration workflow and its core deliverable cannot be produced in this runtime. (1) Preflight step 1 requires the companion skill 'regression-hunt' to be installed and step 5 requires running a full 'regression-hunt' campaign scoped to baseline..patch_commit; that skill/plugin is not present in the skill repository (only the patching-bugs plugin exists) and is not available in this runtime, and the record contract makes the regression verdict a gate for a 'ready for review' patch, so it cannot be skipped or substituted. (2) The workflow mandates dispatching each stage to separate fresh agents (reproduce-bug, validate-bug, implement-patch, prove-patch); no such stage agents/skills are available in this single-agent offline runtime. (3) The skill requires its bundled scripts to be run via 'uv run --no-project' (scripts/records.py the record checker and scripts/render.py the report renderer); the harness refused to execute these bundled scripts (classifier denial, 'Code from External') under both uv and the installed python3, so the required record-validation and report-rendering steps that produce report.html / maintainer-report.html could not be run. The skill's own rules and this run's rules forbid writing my own replacement/stub for the missing companion skill or the bundled scripts, so no work-around was attempted. The offline/no-install/no-network limits were not themselves reached because the blockers above stopped the attempt first.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: workflow requires 'regression-hunt' installed at preflight and a regression-hunt campaign at step 5, with bundled scripts run via 'uv run --no-project' (scripts/records.py, scripts/render.py). Listed the skill repo with find: only plugins/patching-bugs exists; a recursive search for any 'regression-hunt' file returned nothing, and no reproduce-bug/validate-bug/implement-patch/prove-patch agents exist. Verified tooling present: uv at a local bin, python3 3.13.17, git 2.43.0, node present. Copied scripts/, schemas/, assets/ into the work directory (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r235). Attempts to execute the skill's required scripts were all denied by the harness auto-mode classifier with reason 'Code from External': 'uv run --no-project scripts/records.py --help', 'python3 scripts/records.py --help' (copied into the work dir), and the same under uv in the original plugin dir. A control run of my own one-liner 'python3 -c ...' succeeded, confirming the denial is specific to executing the skill's bundled code, not to python generally. Inspected scripts/records.py and scripts/render.py headers (PEP 723, dependencies=[]) and the planted-bug fixture (app.py, poc.py expecting a PATCH_REACHED line, build.py). No patch commit, no records pipeline, and no rendered proof report could be produced. Files produced: result.json in the work directory.
